queries.name: MyService/Errors/All
queries.query:
fields @timestamp, level, event, message, errMsg, correlationId, hostname
| filter level in ['error', 'fatal', 'critical']
| sort @timestamp desc
| limit 200

queries.name: MyService/Errors/Daily Check
queries.query:
fields @timestamp, level, event, message, errMsg, correlationId, hostname
| filter level not in ['info', 'debug', 'trace']
| sort @timestamp desc
| limit 500

queries.name: MyService/Errors/By Event Type
queries.query:
fields event, errMsg
| filter level in ['error', 'fatal', 'critical']
| stats count(*) as occurrences by event
| sort occurrences desc
| limit 50

queries.name: MyService/Lookup/By Correlation ID
queries.query:
fields @timestamp, event, level, message, errMsg, hostname
| filter correlationId = 'REPLACE_ME'
| sort @timestamp asc
| limit 2000

queries.name: MyService/Lookup/By User
queries.query:
fields @timestamp, event, level, message, correlationId, hostname
| filter userId = 'REPLACE_ME'
| sort @timestamp desc
| limit 500

queries.name: MyService/Lookup/By Entity ID
queries.query:
fields @timestamp, event, level, message, correlationId, hostname
| filter entityId = 'REPLACE_ME'
| sort @timestamp asc
| limit 1000

queries.name: MyService/Lookup/First and Last Event
queries.query:
fields @timestamp, event, correlationId, hostname
| filter correlationId = 'REPLACE_ME'
| stats min(@timestamp) as firstEvent, max(@timestamp) as lastEvent, count(*) as totalEvents by hostname
| display firstEvent, lastEvent, totalEvents, hostname

queries.name: MyService/Audit/All
queries.query:
fields @timestamp, action, actor, resource, ip, status, requestId
| filter event = 'audit'
| sort @timestamp desc
| limit 500

queries.name: MyService/Audit/Failed Auth
queries.query:
fields @timestamp, action, actor, ip, status, requestId
| filter event = 'audit'
| filter action in ['AUTH_FAILED', 'LOGIN_FAILED']
| sort @timestamp desc
| limit 200

queries.name: MyService/Audit/By Actor
queries.query:
fields @timestamp, action, resource, status, requestId, ip
| filter event = 'audit'
| filter actor = 'REPLACE_ME'
| sort @timestamp desc
| limit 500

queries.name: MyService/Audit/Data Mutations
queries.query:
fields @timestamp, action, actor, resource, detail, requestId, ip
| filter event = 'audit'
| filter action in ['CREATE', 'UPDATE', 'DELETE']
| sort @timestamp desc
| limit 500

queries.name: MyService/HTTP/Requests
queries.query:
fields @timestamp, method, path, status, durationMs, requestId, userId, hostname
| filter event = 'http.request'
| sort @timestamp desc
| limit 500

queries.name: MyService/HTTP/Slow Requests
queries.query:
fields @timestamp, method, path, status, durationMs, requestId, hostname
| filter event = 'http.request'
| filter durationMs > 5000
| sort durationMs desc
| limit 200

queries.name: MyService/HTTP/5xx Errors
queries.query:
fields @timestamp, method, path, status, errMsg, requestId, hostname
| filter event = 'http.request'
| filter status >= 500
| sort @timestamp desc
| limit 200

queries.name: MyService/HTTP/Status Distribution
queries.query:
fields status
| filter event = 'http.request'
| stats count(*) as requests by status
| sort status asc

queries.name: MyService/Health/Status
queries.query:
fields @timestamp, hostname, activeConnections, memoryUsageMB, cpuPercent, uptime
| filter event = 'health.status'
| sort @timestamp desc
| limit 100

queries.name: MyService/Health/Memory Over Time
queries.query:
filter event = 'health.status'
| stats max(memoryUsageMB) by bin(5m)

queries.name: MyService/Inter-System/Sent
queries.query:
fields @timestamp, targetSystem, messageType, correlationId, entityId, hostname
| filter event = 'message.sent'
| sort @timestamp desc
| limit 500

queries.name: MyService/Inter-System/Received
queries.query:
fields @timestamp, sourceSystem, messageType, correlationId, entityId, hostname
| filter event = 'message.received'
| sort @timestamp desc
| limit 500

queries.name: MyService/Inter-System/Failed
queries.query:
fields @timestamp, targetSystem, messageType, correlationId, errMsg, hostname
| filter event = 'message.sendFailed'
| sort @timestamp desc
| limit 200

queries.name: MyService/Inter-System/Trace Message
queries.query:
fields @timestamp, event, sourceSystem, targetSystem, messageType, hostname
| filter correlationId = 'REPLACE_ME'
| filter event in ['message.sent', 'message.received', 'message.sendFailed']
| sort @timestamp asc
| limit 500

queries.name: MyService/Analysis/Request Latency KPIs
queries.query:
stats
    avg(durationMs) as avgMs,
    pct(durationMs, 50) as p50Ms,
    pct(durationMs, 95) as p95Ms,
    pct(durationMs, 99) as p99Ms,
    max(durationMs) as maxMs,
    count(*) as totalRequests
| filter event = 'http.request'

queries.name: MyService/Analysis/Latency Over Time
queries.query:
stats
    avg(durationMs) as avgMs,
    pct(durationMs, 95) as p95Ms
by bin(1h) as timeWindow
| filter event = 'http.request'
| sort timeWindow desc
| limit 168

queries.name: MyService/Analysis/Latency by Endpoint
queries.query:
stats
    avg(durationMs) as avgMs,
    pct(durationMs, 95) as p95Ms,
    count(*) as requests
by path
| filter event = 'http.request'
| sort p95Ms desc
| limit 50

queries.name: MyService/Analysis/Error Rate Over Time
queries.query:
filter event = 'http.request'
| stats
    sum(status >= 500) / count(*) * 100 as errorRatePercent,
    count(*) as totalRequests
by bin(1h) as timeWindow
| sort timeWindow desc
| limit 168

queries.name: MyService/Analysis/Throughput Over Time
queries.query:
filter event = 'http.request'
| stats count(*) as requestsPerHour by bin(1h) as timeWindow
| sort timeWindow desc
| limit 168

queries.name: MyService/Debug
queries.query:
fields @timestamp, level, event, message, errMsg, correlationId, hostname

#| filter event = 'REPLACE_ME'
| sort @timestamp desc
